verdict.rationale: telli's REST API documents scheduling outbound calls and importing phone numbers from your own SIP trunk. Inbound calling is documented only as platform setup (call forwarding or SIP trunk connection), not as an API capability, and no API for purchasing or provisioning new telli numbers is shown. Missing for 10: API-based purchase/provisioning of new numbers, API-driven inbound call handling, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can provision phone numbers and run both inbound and outbound calls through the platform's API

citations.quote: Use telli's REST API to programmatically manage contacts, schedule calls, and integrate with your existing systems.
Schedules a call at the earliest opportunity within the dialer window.
Imports a phone number from your own SIP trunk provider.
Connect an existing number and phone system for incoming and outgoing calls.
